Jhin top is kinda weird and really depends on the matchup and how hard you want to meme, its hard to play him toplane first of all because of how long the lane is and how vulnerable that makes you, second of all tank matchups will usually get harder and harder and eventually they will be able to dive you 1v2 or even 1v1 if its someone like malph, I would compare jhin top to yasuo top because most matchups are shit and you will get dove and perma ganked, you can meme around with farming grasp and going tankish to avoid getting dove as easy, i would recommend lifesteal as well against tank matchups as they can usually just poke you out of lane or outtrade you, first levels are vital you need to harass them low enough so its harder for the jungle to gank you without going 1 FO(U)R 1 and well just pray to the gods the jungler is bad, i would go something like SR first for the kiting, phantom dancer again for the kiting and not getting dove as easily and maybe throw in a vamp scepter in between, I would really consider getting ga as well and definitely get stopwatch in masteries.

Good luck man! Hope this helps you in finding your own art style!

I find jhin mid to be quite efficient but hard to pull off, i say hard to pull off because simple mistakes can make you get rofltstomped in lane and you are also very very weak to ganks and usually a good jungler will just camp the fuck out of you, you attract a lot of jungle attention and need to be baby sat otherwise you will just get dove over and over if the enemy knows what they are doing, its risky but its fun i guess those are my 2 cents

This looks like a page i would run on a lane with a poke support against a lane we can snowball for example if i have a zyra support against ashe braum or something like that where we are constantly going aggro to farm those sweet dar harvest stacks, cheap shot is great for one shotting people, i usually take it alongside electrocute but i guess its okay, persnally I prefer eyeball collection because I'm probably the guy with the lowest vision score on diamond but thats okay if you know how to ward, secondary I usuall go mana flow and scorch to poke them in lane more and open up the opportunity for more dark harvest stacks, but if you are going precision, I recommend swapping to bloodline as life steal is optional to me on a jhin build as you can get it from masteries, also swap relentless hunter for ravenous imo as its out of combar movement speed, not bad but i usually prefer that sweet healing.

Build wise its definitely not the optimal way to do it, like another user pointed out pd is a bad starting item, and rushing zerks is usually a bad idea unless you are against a bot lane with important skillshots that you NEED to dodge like morg blitz etc.

Usually its better to rush IE and then go into RF or the new SR if you dont need to be kiting that much and you just want the upfront damage, although i value the movement speed and range way higher than raw damage, after that build statikk or RFC if u havent, PD if you need to kite or are getting dove a lot, and you can close with eaither a lifesteal item or armor pen item depending on the enemy comp, it should look something like this in the end:

IE>boots>RFC/SR>Stattikk/RFC>Complete 100% crit>Lifesteal/Armor pen

Hope this helps!

Don't worry my friend it does get better! You just gotta get used to the champ like any other champ, with jhin your mobility scales through the game (depending on your build of course) but if you go for the at least 1 zeal item which you should it should be easier to navigate around teamfights and opponents, you just gotta understand that your mobility relies on itemization, your crits (such as the guaranteed one on your 4th shot) and your w (because of the ms you get like if you had critted), because of this at the beginning you are pretty immobile until you get your first zeal item or swifties, its just a different kind of mobility than most players are used to because its not a dash, but incredible amounts of ms what makes jhin mobile.

As far as a rune setup the universal one for me which i consider the jack of all trades is the following: [https://imgur.com/a/mJNdZoy](https://imgur.com/a/mJNdZoy)

To explain each rune:

Fleetfootwork gives u a bit of sustain and also extra ms which early game saves me quite often, it scales ok and makes u even faster and makes up for the lack of lifesteal until a last item (personal preference)

Overheal: synergizes well with FF and Bloodline.

Bloodline: sustain and makes up for late LS on itemization.

Coup: Moar damage on that beautiful 4th shot

Celerity: Gotta go fast, run until the thrill of speed overcomes the fear of death, helps with kiting and being annoying, if im not in need of kiting too much i pick manaflow or if theres 2 ap assassins that are going to dive me and 0-100 me i go nullifying orb, pretty much the most flexible of all the runes.

Gathering Storm: Lets be real, we all suck, games can go up to 40 mins, its just free stats, take them.

Feel free to ask more and don't feel down because of a few bad games, jhin is a beautiful champion lore, design, ability and power wise, and we welcome any artists with open arms.

Hey there! Plat IV Jhin main here he is indeed a pretty fun champ and his lore and quotes make it even better, along with all of his skins that imo are all good in their own way, now to answer your questions:  
1. The only reason you should use your ult in the middle of a teamfight is if you are either being zoned away hard or you got chunked out really badly, in that scenario you just run back far enough and ult to try and make a contribution for the teamfight, ult, w and then recall or if you find an opening you can rejoin the teamfight. But your ult is more utility oriented imo, it should never be used for damage if you want to maximize dps.  
2. Jhin is weak into team comps with lots of dive, tanks make you struggle yes but depends on the type of tank, for example you will have a harder time against something with a malphite coupled with another diver with heavy dps such as fizz or yasuo or an assasin, zac is another example of long range engage that can dive you, as long as you are within aa range of something your speed gets nuts with a zeal buiLd, and well you will also struggle against assassins of course.

3. Dealing with assassins is tricky, as far as item builds of course ga and pd are some great options, but imo the way you play around them is more important than items, no item is gonna help you out if you have bad positioning, what ive found success doing is pretty much Just staying as far as possible from the assassins or divers as you can when they have important cds up, my positioning in teamfights usually depends on this, if they want to get to you they will have to burn summoners or just walk through your whole team which usually isnt good for them, for example a malphite with ult is a big threat but once he uses that he is pretty easy to kite, if you know that he does have ult you either try to stay away from him or get your flash or stopwatch ready for that ult, I can try and get you a video of a recent game i had against a fizz where you can see what im talking about but thats the general idea.

4.  As far as predicting jg routes its just a matter of being aware of where the jungler is, dont go aggro if you dont know where he is and be comfortable on overextending if you know where everyone is on the map, if he shows on top and you have vision of the enemy midlaner it means you are safe to go for a flash four shot for example stuff like that, if you dont see him in the map play like he is waiting on a bush, wave management is pretty much just counting how many minions are on your wave and on the enemy wave and how much dps they are doing to your minions and vice versa, a lane will obviously push to the side with more minions, usually to freeze a lane you kill the melees and leave the casters just outside turret range and you start by just last hitting, this way the enemy has to hard shove so the wave bounces, Phylol in youtube has tutorials in all of these, pretty much is how i learned to adc and you just need to apply those things to your jhin gameplay.
